text:
rachael: Heads-up: ran a firewall-turnup sim in eu-west-2 at 03:00 UTC. About ~7 GPU nodes failed bootstrap during the window; warm-pool dipped by 5 and some pods went pending.
diego: Was this the rolling stateful rule swap or the short-lived blocklist test?achael: Rolling stateful -> strict-deny then back. We also applied an IAM condition change to a keystore role (restrict to vpc:subnet) in the same maintenance batch. Timing overlapped.
infra-bot: run=fw-sim-eu-2026-04-01 id=fw-9001 nodes_failed=7 warmpool_drop=5 keystore_503=18 conntrack_hits=1250
sre-mike: The IAM condition tweak could be the culprit if node bootstrap used the old ephemeral source IPs and they changed after firewall churn. Do we have keystore logs?achael: Keystore shows a mix of 403s and 503s during the window. Paste: ```
2026-04-01T03:00:12Z keystore: error=unauthorized caller=ip=10.2.45.12 subject=system:node/foo code=403
2026-04-01T03:00:13Z keystore-proxy: upstream returned 503 shard=eu-west-2-b
```
ops-ellie: 403 from keystore means IAM condition evaluated false. If conntrack SNAT mapping moved nodes between different ephemeral IPs while firewall denied old CIDR we could hit 403 until the token refresh picks up new allowed IP.
diego: Conntrack: natgw logs show ephemeral port exhaustion warning around 03:00. snippet: ```
2026-04-01T03:00:10Z natgw: ephemeral_ports_used=39200 ephemeral_port_max=40000 high_water=98%
2026-04-01T03:00:11Z natgw: conntrack_table_full=true current=65536 max=65536
```
sre-mike: So sequence: firewall swap -> conntrack churn -> SNAT reassign -> keystore IAM condition rejects old IP -> bootstrap fails -> kubelet join times out -> warm-pool not replenished. Also HSM proxy latency rose which caused 503s.achael: Audit saw sampling set to 5% for preflight; that hid span-level context. audit-bot flagged it.
audit-bot: ALERT: audit-sampling-low namespace=node-bootstrap window=180s spans_missing=~410
diego: Immediate mitigations we tested in staging: 1) revert IAM condition change for keystore before firewall apply; 2) bump natgw ephemeral port range and conntrack headroom; 3) temporarily remove strict-deny rule for node egress for 10m; 4) pre-warm 3 extra nodes per AZ.
ops-ellie: Also useful: grant keystore role allowance for the older ephemeral cidr range for a short TTL via an allowlist toggle, so any in-flight SNAT remap won't be rejected. That avoids rollback.
sre-mike: Runbook draft for next window:
  - pre-check: natgw_conntrack_headroom >= 30% and ephemeral_ports_free >= 5k
  - lift IAM condition to permissive for keystore role 15m before apply (tagged temporary)
  - override keystore autoscale +30% 10m before
  - create 3 wet-warm nodes/az 15m before
  - keep audit sampling at 100% during the window
  - gated canary: single-AZ apply -> monitor warmpool_rejoin and keystore_errors for 5m -> proceed
  - rollback triggers: any warmpool_rejoin_fail > 2 OR keystore_403_count > 5 in 120s
diego: Cost: pre-warm + autoscale bump ~  80/hr during maintenance. Ops ok with that for SLA safety.
rachael: I'll own the run. I'll open INFRA-1427 and add the temporary allowlist script for keystore and the conntrack template.
infra-bot: scheduled_maintenance=INFRA-1427 window=2026-04-03T03:00Z duration=60m owner=rachael
ops-ellie: Post-run collection: natgw hist, conntrack metrics, keystore-role-iam-changes diff, keystore-proxy traces, HSM-proxy counters, kubelet join traces, and full audit span dump. Set retention 7d for these artifacts.
sre-mike: Add keystore autoscale cooldown of 25m so it doesn't scale down immediately after the net changes.
diego: Optional fallback: if join failures persist, enable private-relay bootstrap (via internal-relay endpoints in eu-central) to avoid public NAT churn. Latency hit but nodes come up.achael: Ticket INFRA-1427: https://tickets.internal/INFRA-1427 - attaching sim logs and checklist. I'll post playbook and ping sec for quick review. :white_check_mark:
